diagnosis: At 13a08deaa CollectorRunner.refresh_security_listing and publish_security_listing existed but no CLI command and no systemd unit called them, so state/security-listing.json was never initialised and bundles/security-listing.jsonl never published; hosted PR 7521 (shadow mode) had nothing to read.

fix.command: collector_stack --root-dir /data refresh-listing [--date YYYY-MM-DD] (cli.py); CollectorRunner.refresh_listing_for_day (runner.py): policy-checked PolicyEnforcedFetcher with the collector contact User-Agent, idempotent per day, publishes bundles/security-listing.jsonl, records collector-tw-security-listing in status.json; exit 0 ok/skipped, 2 failed (fail closed).
fix.timer: systemd/pantheon-collector-listing.timer: Mon-Fri 08:30 and retry 10:30 Asia/Taipei, both before 13:30 Taipei (05:30Z); README documents enable and rollback.

first_filter_day_rule: Until the first successful refresh the host collects unfiltered. From the first collection after it succeeds, collector-tw-twse-t86, collector-tw-twse-price-history, collector-tw-tpex-price-history and collector-tw-trading-suspension run in listed_only mode; with the 08:30 timer the first filtered day is the same trading day as the first successful refresh (the day deployed, if before the 13:30 runs). Rollback: COLLECTOR_WARRANTS_MODE=off.
